hotContext.criticalNews: Terafab groundbreaking confirmed August 6; JETI tax abatements signed and active; civil work and foundation prep underway in Grimes County. First phase $16.8B investment; total project scope ~$119B across four phases. 100+ million sq ft facility targeting 3,000+ jobs and production of logic, memory, and packaging chips for Tesla and SpaceX.

recentKeyChanges.title: Tesla, SpaceX Confirm Terafab Groundbreaking: $16.8B First Phase, 100M Sq Ft, Civil Work Underway
recentKeyChanges.description: On August 6, 2026, Tesla and SpaceX made an official public announcement confirming the Terafab chip manufacturing facility in Grimes County, Texas will proceed with $16.8 billion in first-phase investment. Governor Abbott endorsed the project publicly, and SpaceX representatives met with Grimes County residents on August 5-6, confirming JETI tax agreements are signed/active and civil work and foundation preparation are starting 'almost immediately.' The facility is planned at 100+ million square feet — designed to be 'the largest and most valuable building on Earth by far' (Musk's public statement). The plant will vertically integrate logic, memory, packaging, and testing; employ at least 3,000 people; and supply chips for Tesla Optimus robots, Cybercabs, and SpaceX space-based data centers. Build permits were issued around July 26 (four building permits for the Advanced Technology Chip Fabrication facility), and foundation work (excavation, GeoPiers, gravel base) is visibly progressing. The Texas Enterprise Fund granted $30 million toward the project, and SpaceX paid $10 million to Grimes County satisfying a deal milestone. Total multi-phase project scope remains at ~$119 billion. This marks the transition from political/tax approval track (completed July 21-23 with JETI signing) to active site preparation and early construction.

positive_signals: Official announcement by Tesla/SpaceX on August 6 with Governor Abbott public endorsement
JETI tax agreements confirmed signed and active by SpaceX reps at county meeting
Four building permits issued around July 26 specifically for Advanced Technology Chip Fabrication facility
Foundation prep work (excavation, GeoPiers, gravel base) visibly underway and accelerating per drone observations
Civil work and foundation prep to start 'almost immediately' per official SpaceX statement
$16.8 billion first-phase capital commitment announced and publicly confirmed
Texas Enterprise Fund $30 million grant awarded; $10 million payment to Grimes County completed by SpaceX
100+ million square foot vertically integrated facility design (logic, memory, packaging, testing under one roof)
3,000+ planned jobs from Grimes and Brazos County
Specific supply commitments articulated: Optimus chips, Cybercab chips, SpaceX data center chips
negative_signals: Terafab still remains pre-production; first-phase is ~$16.8B of ~$119B total project cost
No specific timeline given for when production will begin (only 'months' for full-scale construction)
Foundation work is early-stage civil; tool installation, process qualification, and first wafer production remain years away
Land rights and environmental permitting (water, noise, traffic) still ongoing; community opposition voiced at county meeting
First-phase alone expected to take multiple years; multi-phase build-out extends well past 2026
Project described as 'high-risk, high-payoff' by Musk earlier; execution risk acknowledged in Q2 earnings
